_doc: R3 P1 §12 C1 — REVIEWED page timer bounds (contract/timer-bounds.js). pages: the asserted pages and the settle() horizon their steps use. wrappers: reviewed timer wrapper names per unit. sites: every timer whose delay exceeds the page horizon or is unresolved, with reachesAsserted (does its effect reach an output a step asserts?) and the reason; bound to the call text (sha256). chains: every timer CHAIN (callback arming another timer, name-resolved within the unit) whose cumulative delay exceeds the horizon, is unresolved or repeats — { cumulativeBoundMs, repeatLimit, reachesAsserted, reason } bound to its call texts. periodic: every interval firing within the horizon — { periodMs, mayChange, mayChangeSelectors (blanked by the §5b recapture), changesAsserted:false }.
